column1: # registry.tsv — the binding repos scripts/bindings/bump.sh fans engine-pin
# bumps out to. One row per binding; TAB-separated, three or four fields:
#   repo<TAB>pin-file-globs<TAB>base-branch[<TAB>version-file]
#   repo            GitHub ORG/NAME of the binding (ssh clone/push target).
#   pin-file-globs  space-separated globs, relative to the binding repo root,
#                   matching every file that pins or references the engine
#                   tag. A tag inside a pin-shaped context (tag = "vX.Y.Z",
#                   ?tag=vX.Y.Z, NAME..VERSION..=, PIN=) is a VOTE on what the
#                   repo's pin is; all other occurrences are prose references
#                   that get substituted along with it. Globs that match
#                   nothing are reported (e.g. an optional .engine-pin).
#   base-branch     branch the bump/vX.Y.Z branch is cut from and the PR base.
#   version-file    OPTIONAL (4th field): the binding's OWN package-version
#                   file (package.json / pyproject.toml / pubspec.yaml). When
#                   present, the bump PR also sets its version to the tag's
#                   bare X.Y.Z — release parity: the binding publishes at the
#                   engine's version — and --release-after-merge refuses to
#                   tag the repo unless the version matches. Registry-less
#                   repos (c/go/cpp/zig/jvm/php) omit it: they are tagged for
#                   pinning only (php's tag IS the Packagist release; its
#                   composer.json carries no version field by Packagist
#                   convention — Packagist derives it from the tag).
# A new binding registers itself by adding ONE line here (see README.md).
